SELECT 
    dr.province AS 省份,
    SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025
GROUP BY dr.province
ORDER BY 省份

SELECT 
  dr.region_name AS 地区,
  SUM(do.daily_sales) AS 销售额
FROM dws_order_daily do
JOIN dim_region dr ON do.region_id = dr.region_id
WHERE do.stat_date >= 20250101 AND do.stat_date <= 20251231
GROUP BY dr.region_name

SELECT 
  dp.brand AS 品牌,
  SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fo.date_id >= 20250101 AND fo.date_id <= 20251231
GROUP BY dp.brand
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

SELECT 
  d.quarter AS 季度,
  SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025
GROUP BY d.quarter
ORDER BY 
  CASE d.quarter 
    WHEN 'Q1' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Q2' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Q3' THEN 3 
    WHEN 'Q4' THEN 4 
  END

SELECT 
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS year,
  MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM fact_order
WHERE date_id >= 20250101 AND date_id <= 20251231
GROUP BY 
  YEAR(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d')),
  MONTH(STR_TO_DATE(CAST(date_id AS CHAR), '%Y%m%d'))
ORDER BY year, month
